note: Sections that a public build can leave out or hide. A build with VITE_PUBLIC_BUILD=1 (gallery/share/publish_pages.py's GitHub deploy, build_share.py) swaps every section with "public": false for src/sections/omitted.ts, so none of its code is compiled, and the publish scripts leave its data folders (under public/data) out of the archive. "public": "unlisted" publishes the section's code and data, but the header menu and search leave its tabs out: they open from a link (#tab=aethalometer), like Experimental, and its fields join the other tabs' pickers only in a full build. Set "public": true to list it. A local `npm run dev` or `npm run build` always includes and lists every section.
